tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page. Every screen and every ruled cell sits directly on it.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The darker off-grey behind a drawn phone or a demo; never behind text blocks inside the product.

tokens.name: raise
tokens.usage: Inside a text field, and a row under the pointer. Not a card colour.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Rules between sections, cell dividers, quiet button and tag outlines. Structure only, never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Rules between rows inside one section.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, titles, values, numerals, field and primary outlines. On ground 14.9:1, on raise 16.3:1, on band 13.6:1.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Supporting text, labels, units. On ground 6.0:1, on raise 6.5:1, on band 5.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Index numbers, placeholders, bracket corners. On ground 4.6:1, on raise 5.0:1. Not on band.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Only the dimmed second clause of a display sentence (24px and larger). On ground 3.7:1.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Fills of bars that are not the leader and not now: share segments, ranked bars, month bars, the hatch. On ground 3.2:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ultramarine. Section labels, the chosen rule tab, the one filled action per screen, the bar that means now, links. As text on ground 6.6:1; as a fill it carries on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (7.9:1). The start flow flood uses ground on accent instead (6.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: A tinted fill behind accent text where a quiet highlight is needed. Accent on it 6.2:1.

tokens.name: urgent
tokens.usage: Deadlines within 7 days: the numeral, its unit, an urgent tag; a negative amount in a table. Nothing else. On ground 5.2:1.

tokens.name: urgent-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind urgent text where one is needed. Urgent on it 4.9:1.

families.sans: "Instrument Sans", "Instrument Sans Ext", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The answer of a phone screen. One per screen. The second clause takes dim.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Autobusų stotelių remonto darbai su projektavimu
styles.usage: The name of the thing a screen is about: a tender, a buyer, a firm, a detail screen.

styles.name: finding
styles.usage: The sentence of a Finding. 22/27 on desktop.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: The title of a row, exactly as the buyer wrote it, clamped to two lines. 17/23 on desktop.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Per 5 metus atlikti gatvių ar kelių remonto darbai už ne mažiau kaip 200 000 €.
styles.usage: An answer inside a section: a requirement, a lead sentence over a picture.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Supporting lines in ink-2: buyer, deadline, typical value.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Upper case. Section names in accent; field and cell labels in ink-2.

styles.name: index
styles.usage: Counts and index numbers in ink-3: two digits in a section head and a list, three on a Finding.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Upper case, inside a square outlined tag.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: A figure that is the point of a cell: days left, a count, a sum. Its unit follows in 13px ink-2.

styles.name: numeral-row
styles.usage: Days left at the left of a list row.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a title and its supporting line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rule tabs; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a bracket; between the parts of a Finding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Above and below the content of a row.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The page inset on a phone: every left edge sits on it.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between stacked fields and blocks of a form.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: The page inset on desktop.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: The smallest height of anything pressable.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: The top bar of a phone screen.

tokens.name: tab-h
tokens.usage: The bottom tab bar; the desktop top bar.

tokens.name: when-col
tokens.usage: The numeral column at the left of a list row on a phone (92px on desktop).

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The widest the desktop sheet gets; its two side rules run the full height.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: cells, buttons, tags, fields, sheets, bars. The spinner is the only circle.
